title: MockMachina project settings
description: .mockmachina/config.yaml. Optional; every field has a default, and command-line flags win over it.

version.description: File format version, so later releases can migrate old projects.

host.description: Address to listen on. 127.0.0.1 by default; 0.0.0.0 lets phones on your network connect.

mock.description: Port the mock API is served on. Defaults to 4001.

seed.description: Seed for everything random: fake data, random states, jitter, fault rates. 0 picks one at start and logs it; --seed overrides it.

locale.description: Language and region for fake data. Defaults to en.

proxy.description: The real backend. mockmachina start sends requests that match no route, and routes with serve: proxy, here. --proxy overrides it.
